name: Richard E. Neal

pages.title: Richard Neal for Congress
pages.text:
## A PROMISE.
I’m proud to work for the people of Western and Central Mass. As your Congressman, I’ve fought tirelessly for policies that make a difference for hard-working families and future generations: fairer taxes, affordable and accessible healthcare, taking on climate change, preserving Social Security, and more.
Today, we face profound challenges. Longstanding racial injustice is finally being confronted. A pandemic has turned lives upside down. And through it all, we have a President who has turned his back on our problems, sowed division, and fanned the flames of hate.
These challenges may be daunting, but my promise to you remains the same: I will always have your back. I went to Congress to fight for hard-working families across this district and across America, and that’s exactly what I intend to keep doing.

## A PROMISE.
I’m proud to work for the people of Western and Central Mass. As your Congressman, I’ve fought tirelessly for policies that make a difference for hard-working families and future generations: fairer taxes, affordable and accessible healthcare, taking on climate change, preserving Social Security, and more.
Working with President Biden, we’ve made historic progress by delivering generational investments in our infrastructure, passing the largest legislation ever to tackle climate change, addressing racial injustice and creating tens of thousands of good-paying jobs. And we have so much work left to do.
But this year, we face challenges not only to all the progress we’ve made, but to American democracy itself.
These challenges may be daunting, but my promise to you remains the same: I will always have your back. I went to Congress to fight for hard-working families across this district and across America, and that’s exactly what I intend to keep doing.

## A PROMISE.
A trip to the grocery store costs more than it used to. So does filling a prescription. I know the middle class needs help. Donald Trump gave billions in tax cuts to the very wealthy. That's why I'm taking on Trump, fighting for middle-class tax cuts, investing in our communities, ending the tariffs that raise your prices, and opposing reckless wars that threaten our security and our economy.
I'm proud to work for the people of Western and Central Massachusetts. As your Congressman, I've fought tirelessly for hard-working families and future generations by protecting Social Security and Medicare, lowering costs, standing up to Donald Trump's abuse of power, and making sure our region gets its fair share.
My promise to you remains the same: I will always have your back. It is an honor to serve as your Congressman, and I would be grateful for the opportunity to earn your vote because I'm not done fighting.
